diagnosis: The SSE route streams live GPS coordinates for deliveryId without validating whether req.user.id is either the sender, recipient, or assigned courier for the delivery. An attacker can track courier location and destination address in real time.
exploit_request:
GET /api/deliveries/deliv_981023/live-tracking HTTP/1.1
Host: tracker.fooddelivery.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Accept: text/event-stream
